chatfilter_chattag.title: Chat Filter & Custom Tags
chatfilter_chattag.help.name_color: Insert the formatting sign followed by 0–9 or a–f (6 is gold). Leave it empty or use the sign followed by r to keep the original name color.
chatfilter_chattag.invalid_name_color: Use a color code, reset code, or leave Name color empty.
chatfilter_chattag.help.pattern: Exact, case-sensitive text. No regular expressions.
chatfilter_chattag.help.replacement: Plain text; leave blank to remove the match.
chatfilter_chattag.help.sample: Preview your draft using the first matching enabled rule.
chatfilter_chattag.help.account: Minecraft account name or hyphenated UUID; case-insensitive. UUID takes priority.
chatfilter_chattag.help.insert_section: Insert the formatting sign at the cursor, or replace the selection. Shortcut: Ctrl + Shift + F8.
chatfilter_chattag.help.prefix: Paste color and style codes, or insert the formatting sign with the adjacent button or Ctrl + Shift + F8. Spaces around the name are added automatically.
chatfilter_chattag.help.suffix: Paste color and style codes, or insert the formatting sign with the adjacent button or Ctrl + Shift + F8. Spaces around the name are added automatically.
chatfilter_chattag.empty_list: No entries. Choose Add to create one.
chatfilter_chattag.invalid: Check rule text and invalid or duplicate accounts.
chatfilter_chattag.load_error: Config unreadable. Fix it and restart; file kept.
chatfilter_chattag.save_error: Not saved. Check the client log.
chatfilter_chattag.help.add_book: Choose one local UTF-8 .md or .json file (up to 1 MiB). New rules are added to the draft; Save applies them.
chatfilter_chattag.book_added: Added to draft: %s. Save to apply.
chatfilter_chattag.book_picker_error: Could not open the file picker.
chatfilter_chattag.book_read_error: Cannot read word list. Check file format and size.
chatfilter_chattag.book_draft_error: Fix invalid rule text before importing.
chatfilter_chattag.book_limit: Import would exceed the limit of %s rules.
chatfilter_chattag.screen_small: Use GUI scale or resize to at least %s × %s.
chatfilter_chattag.help.current_server: Fill the selected draft with the current server address, or open its existing entry. Available on remote, non-LAN servers only.
chatfilter_chattag.help.server_address: Use the address you connected to, including any non-default port. Host case and default port 25565 are ignored; no DNS lookup.
chatfilter_chattag.help.server_template: Match the exact layout and spaces. Use {name} once and {message} at the end. Examples: [{rank}] {name}: {message}, {name}: {message}, <{name}> {message}. Use punctuation to delimit slots.
chatfilter_chattag.help.server_alias: Optional, exact display name for this server. Leave blank for the login name. Set tags under Player Tags using your real account or UUID.
chatfilter_chattag.servers_empty: Off. Add a format to enable it for a server.
chatfilter_chattag.servers_scope: Save to enable. Display only; not proof of identity.
chatfilter_chattag.invalid_server: Check the server address, template or alias.
chatfilter_chattag.duplicate_server: This address already has a format.
chatfilter_chattag.help.search_name: Enter one name word (e.g. qaz). Clear it and Save to turn off automatic matching for this address.
chatfilter_chattag.help.auto_match: Start searching the current server. Save to keep searching on reconnect. Only choosing a candidate and saving applies a match.
chatfilter_chattag.button.candidate_empt: Enter a name and click Auto Match
chatfilter_chattag.help.candidate: Title: %s · {name}: %s. Select and Save to apply to your account. Text-only chat is not proof of identity.
chatfilter_chattag.help.candidate_ambigu: Title: %s · {name}: %s. No unique base name; use the exact search name or the manual alias.
chatfilter_chattag.help.matched_name: This is exactly the template's {name} slot, not necessarily the full title. A selected match replaces your manual alias only for your account after Save.
chatfilter_chattag.invalid_search_name: Enter one name word, without formatting or spaces.
chatfilter_chattag.search_not_armed: Click Auto Match to set the new search name.
chatfilter_chattag.search_draft: Save the search to keep it after reconnecting.
chatfilter_chattag.candidate_draft: Candidate selected. Save to apply it.
chatfilter_chattag.candidate_expired: Connection changed. Select a new candidate.
